contracts: TimedPointCloud requires finite Nx3 points and one finite timestamp per point
PoseSample requires finite timestamped homogeneous SE(3) T_OB
T_B_L must be a finite rigid homogeneous transform
pose history must be strictly increasing and cover all point/reference times
unsupported samples are rejected; no arbitrary extrapolation is performed
correction follows (T_OB(t_ref) T_B_L)^-1 T_OB(t_i) T_B_L p_i
input arrays are copied and are not mutated
translation is interpolated linearly and attitude with quaternion SLERP

fixtures: static wall under translation and yaw with non-identity 3D extrinsic
interpolated translation and SLERP attitude versus nearest-pose behavior
empty cloud and strict TimedPointCloud type contract
empty, duplicate and unsorted pose history rejection
limitations: The SIL fixture validates the transform contract, not Livox driver timestamp semantics.
The real T_B_L calibration and frame ownership require the robot and authorized ROS graph.
No physical motion, driver timeout or hardware stop behavior is inferred from this report.
